description_en: Deletes an episode from a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-caster-episode --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --episode-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf9327380000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCasterEpisode

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

- If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value from the response.

- If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The production studio name on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The episode ID. If you added the episode by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848068.html operation, use the EpisodeId value from the response
parameters.help_zh: 节目ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848068.html添加导播台节目，请查看AddCasterEpisode接口调用返回的参数EpisodeId值
parameters.name: episode_id
